correctness.rationale: The primitive integral relation is explicitly checked against every graph vertex incidence equation; connected nonbipartite unsigned incidence has rank vertex-count, proving the sole irreducible binomial relation. Differentiate the two disjoint-support monomials: a critical side requires one zero square variable or two zero simple variables. Their minimal radical coordinate primes pair across the sides and give every component. The simple-degree-(s−1) squarefree Veronese ideal has exactly s degree-(s−1) generators and s−1 degree-s syzygies, which yields each Hilbert factor. Generic local leading forms and the S2/R1 criterion prove the transverse types and nonnormal support. The actual standalone checker reproduced all zero patterns, counts, finite Hilbert coefficients and Hessian ranks in seven explicit parameter triples; finite checks support but do not prove all parameters.

value.rationale: Provides a complete explicit three-parameter geometric stratification of a natural graph-edge toric hypersurface, including every singular component (not just maximal dimension), an exact reduced-singular Hilbert series, normality-support geometry and three distinct generic quadratic transverse singularities. It explains how subdividing the connector produces a quadratic number of nonnormal divisors and shifts codimension profiles. These canonical geometric invariants are finer than known odd-cycle normality and Ehrhart-series data.
